ai_summary: This document discloses that Clarus Capital I and ClearEdge LLC, managed by ChrysCapital Associates LLP, acquired 5,027 shares of ADOR WELDING LIMITED via an open market transaction. This acquisition increased their combined stake from 6.99% to 7.02%, triggering a mandatory regulatory disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations for crossing the 7% shareholding threshold. There are no apparent red flags, as this represents a routine update of an increasing minority investment.
